prompt: Which is the first state in India to operationalize an ABDM microsite under the 100 Microsites Project by the National Health Authority?
answer: Mizoram—its capital, Aizawl, was the first to operationalize an ABDM microsite under the National Health Authority’s 100 Microsites Project.
